plan.title: Full Body Endurance & Cardio
plan.description: An intermediate 3-day split designed to build cardiovascular health and muscular endurance through high-repetition sets and timed intervals.

workouts.title: Cardio & Core Circuit
workouts.description: A high-intensity circuit focusing on cardiovascular conditioning and core stability.

workouts.title: Full Body Endurance
workouts.description: High-repetition resistance exercises targeting full-body muscular endurance.

workouts.title: Cardio Burn & Resistance
workouts.description: A hybrid session combining explosive cardio movements with bodyweight resistance.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: A classic cardiovascular exercise that involves the whole body to elevate the heart rate.
exercises.instruction: 1. Stand upright with legs together and arms at your sides. 2. Jump up, spread your legs, and bring your arms overhead. 3. Jump back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: A cardiovascular bodyweight exercise that elevates the heart rate while taxing the core and shoulders.
exercises.instruction: 1. Start in a high plank position. 2. Rapidly drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs as if running in place.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: An intense cardio drill that engages the hip flexors, quads, and core.
exercises.instruction: 1. Stand tall. 2. Run in place, driving your knees as high as possible toward your chest with each step.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.description: A dynamic core exercise targeting the obliques and upper abs.
exercises.instruction: 1. Lie flat on your back with hands behind your head. 2. Lift shoulders off the mat and bring your right elbow to your left knee while straightening the right leg. 3. Alternate sides rapidly.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: A core isometric exercise that builds muscular endurance in the abdominals and stabilizers.
exercises.instruction: 1. Start in a push-up position or on forearms. 2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. 3. Hold the position, keeping abs tight.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: The foundational lower body movement for quads, glutes, and general mobility.
exercises.instruction: 1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Push your hips back and bend your knees. 3. Lower until thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Standard Push-Up
exercises.description: A fundamental bodyweight exercise that builds chest, shoulder, and tricep strength.
exercises.instruction: 1. Start in a high plank position. 2. Lower your body until your chest is just above the floor. 3. Push back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.description: Unilateral exercise for balance and leg endurance.
exercises.instruction: 1. Step forward and lower back knee toward ground. 2. Push up and step forward with the other leg.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: A bodyweight exercise for endurance in the lower back and spinal erectors.
exercises.instruction: 1. Lie face down on floor. 2. Lift arms, chest, and legs simultaneously. 3. Hold for 2 seconds and lower.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: A demanding full-body movement that acts as both resistance training and intense cardio.
exercises.instruction: 1. Start standing. 2. Drop into a squat and place hands on the floor. 3. Jump feet back into a plank and do a push-up. 4. Jump feet forward and explosively stand up, jumping into the air.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: A floor exercise that targets the glutes and hamstrings for endurance.
exercises.instruction: 1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. 2. Squeeze your glutes and push your hips toward the ceiling. 3. Lower slowly.
